description.ja: マウス全身 microCT・臓器ラベル付き（{mb}）
description.en: Mouse whole-body micro-CT with organ labels ({mb})

credit.name: Rosenhain / Magnuska / Yamoah / Rawashdeh / Kiessling / Gremse, RWTH Aachen University

changes.ja: 元の Analyze 形式データから体部を切り出して DICOM に変換、付属の臓器セグメンテーションをそのままセグメントとして登録（骨＝骨ラベル、肺＝肺＋気管ラベル、臓器類は造影セグメントに合体）、さらに心臓・膀胱・腎臓・胃・筋肉・脾臓・肝臓・腸と肺・気管を子セグメントとして個別に登録、本アプリで3D再構成
changes.en: cropped to the body and converted from the original Analyze format to DICOM; the bundled organ segmentations registered as-is as segment masks (bone label on the bone segment, lung + trachea labels on the lung segment, all organ labels combined on the contrast segment); the heart, bladder, kidneys, stomach, muscle, spleen, liver and intestine, plus lung and trachea, also registered individually as child segments; 3D reconstruction and rendering in this app
